QuestionStmt.S:
Match List I with List II.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
\text{List I} & \text{List II} \\
\hline
\text{(A). Inductive effect} & \text{(I). Delocalization of } \pi \text{ electrons} \\
\text{(B). Hyper-conjugation} & \text{(II). Displacement of } \pi \text{ electrons} \\
\text{(C). Resonance effect} & \text{(III). Delocalization of } \sigma \text{ electrons} \\
 & \text{(IV). Displacement of } \sigma \text{ electrons} \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

Solution.S:
Inductive effect is the permanent displacement of σ electrons along a carbon chain due to difference in electronegativity. So, (A) matches with (IV) – Displacement of σ electrons.

Hyper-conjugation involves the delocalization of σ electrons (specifically, σ–π conjugation). So, (B) matches with (III) – Delocalization of σ electrons.

Resonance effect involves the delocalization of π electrons. So, (C) matches with (I) – Delocalization of π electrons.

Thus, the correct matching is (A)-(IV), (B)-(III), (C)-(I), which corresponds to Option A.
